# Metrics fixtures

Sample CI outputs for `tests/unit/metrics.test.ts` and `tests/unit/launch-checklist.test.ts`. The
values are invented to exercise the report and the checklist; they are not measurements and must
never be published as RelKit's numbers.

- `complete/`: every kind of input, all targets met.
- `partial/`: a failing template, one runtime, a stubbed Railway walkthrough and no benchmark.
